How many years' experience do you have as a sous chef?

How many years' experience do you have in the hospitality & tourism industry?
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
Do you hold a current Food Safety certificate?
Do you have experience training & managing kitchen staff?

Business Analyst – Preston VIC

Kogan People Solutions, recruiters, are working with a long-established and successful furniture retailer based in Preston, VIC. The company specialises in premium indoor and outdoor furniture, including sofas, dining furniture, bedroom suites, recliners, and home décor. With multiple retail showrooms, a growing eCommerce presence, and a commitment to exceptional customer experiences, our client is seeking an experienced and qualified Business Analyst to support the continued growth and business transformation.

About the Role:

The new Business Analyst will work across retail, eCommerce, supply chain and operational functions. The successful candidate will work closely with stakeholders to analyse business processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver technology and operational initiatives that enhance efficiency, customer experience and business performance.

•	Tenure – The role is full time and ongoing.

•	Location – Preston VIC

•	Salary – Salary, negotiable in the range of $80k to $90k plus superannuation per annum.

Responsibilities will include:

•	Engage with stakeholders across the business to gather, document and analyse business requirements.

•	Review existing business processes and identify opportunities for operational improvement and automation.

•	Analyse sales, inventory, customer and operational data to support strategic decision-making.

•	Develop business cases, functional specifications, process maps and workflow documentation.

•	Liaise with software vendors, developers and internal stakeholders during system implementation and enhancement projects.

•	Support the implementation of ERP, CRM, eCommerce and other business systems.

•	Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) and coordinate system testing activities.

•	Prepare reports, dashboards and performance metrics to support business objectives.

•	Assist with change management, user training and post-implementation reviews.

•	Ensure solutions align with business objectives and industry best practice.

To be successful in this role you will have:

•	A bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Business, Information Technology, Business Information Systems or a closely related discipline.
•	At least one years of relevant experience as a Business Analyst in a similar setting.

•	Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

•	Proficiency with specific software tools (e.g., ERP systems, WMS, TMS), data analysis tools like Excel, SQL, or BI platforms.

•	Experience documenting business requirements, process mapping and business process improvement.

•	Experience working with ERP, CRM, retail or eCommerce systems will be highly regarded.

•	Advanced communication and documentation skills.

•	A results-driven mindset with a focus on improving company outcomes while achieving personal and team objectives.

•	Ability to multitask and prioritise in a fast-paced environment.

•	Solid references.

You must have unrestricted full time Australian working rights to be considered.

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV.

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

Kogan People Solutions – recruitment excellence

Location: Tongala, VIC 3621 
Tenure: Full-time, Permanent
Comprehensive salary package from $79,499 pa (plus superannuation)

Required Qualification:
•	Diploma in Agriculture or higher equivalent
•	At least 3 years recent relevant work experience

Position Summary:

On behalf of our client, Global Skilled Employment Services is looking for a skilled and experienced Agriculture Technician / AI Technician who have strong communication skills, self-motivated and must have the ability to work independently and as a member of a team.

Major duties includes: 

•	Artificially inseminate livestock for breeding purposes
•	Use understanding of animal anatomy to watch for optimum insemination conditions
•	Provide advice on breeding selection and techniques
•	Maintaining and evaluating records of all insemination history
•	Clean all equipment to ensure sanitary breeding practices
•	Vaccinate animals when needed
•	Handle animals humanely
•	Store semen to perform the insemination
•	Follows proper safety protocols when handling hazardous materials, such as liquid nitrogen
•	Physically observe and inspect all animals and Identify harmful pathogenic micro-organisms, insects, parasites, or fungal infection and perform the proper treatment and controlling methods,
•	When working with livestock, adhere to Animal Welfare and Qualify Codes.
•	Observation for the wellbeing of animals
•	Organizing the movement of the animals for breeding purpose.
•	Report regularly and punctually to the operations manager on the breeding activity of the farm
•	Work effectively as a member of a team to achieve pre-determined team goals.
•	Attend and participate in site and section head meetings, which may be arranged from time to time by the operations manager.
•	Ensure that the company’s obligations under the current legislation are observed and that quality training and work activities are conducted in a safe and responsible manner.
•	Maintain the Farm facilities and associated equipment in a clean and tidy condition.
•	Observe all requirements for confidentiality of company information and the privacy requirements of individuals as enacted by legislation such as the Privacy Act.
•	Observe all company biosecurity requirements
•	Ensure compliance with relevant legislation, statutes and government guidelines.
•	Promote the good standing of the company in the local and wider community by the adoption of a professional, sympathetic and co-operative approach when dealing with others.
•	Undertake any other duties or specific tasks that may be nominated by the assistant or operations manager from time to time.

•	This is a full-time position which may involve weekend work and some unplanned hours of work where the need arises.

Other required skills:

•	Good written and verbal communication skills;
•	Advance knowledge in animal husbandry, animal welfare and legislation, dairy production, and OH&S;
•	Knowledge in computer programs/software is an advantage.


Qualified applicants may apply online.
